spells.notes: Appointed by 전두환 in the 7·13 개각 of 1987. The reshuffle was announced on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 (동아일보, 조선일보 and 중앙일보 of 1987-07-14, the 대통령기록관 schedule and the 대한민국사연표 date it to the 13th) and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1987-07-14, which is the start used here (매일경제 1987-07-14, 한국경제 1987-07-15, and the 총무처 page for his co-appointee 장기오). He was 청와대 대변인 when named and had resigned his 12th-Assembly 전국구 seat in 1986 (na_members_12_22.csv). Still in office when 노태우 took office. The 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 and the new President accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25. Unlike seven of his colleagues he was not reappointed: the 1988-02-19 cabinet list left 정무제1장관 vacant (동아일보 1988-02-19, 조선일보 1988-02-20), and 조선일보 1988-03-02 calls him '전정무장관'. end_reason is resigned because the resignation was accepted and no successor took over that day. The post then stayed vacant until 1988-03-07 (see continuity). The press of 1987 prints the hanja 李鍾律 and 중앙일보 spells the hangul 이종율 in one place. Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

spells.notes: Appointed to the post left vacant since the change of government, on the morning of 1988-03-07, with the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1988-03-07, 매일경제 and 조선일보 1988-03-08, 중앙일보 1988-03-07). He was a former 대통령비서실장 (동아일보 1988-03-07) and not a sitting member (he won a 13th-Assembly seat on 1988-04-26). In the 민정당 당직 개편 of the afternoon of 1988-05-02 he was named 원내총무 (subject to the caucus vote) and 이종찬 was named 정무제1장관. On the morning of 1988-05-03 the President gave 김윤환 his 원내총무 임명장 and then gave 이종찬 his 정무제1장관 임명장 (한국경제 and 한국일보 1988-05-04), so the handover day is 1988-05-03. end_reason is replaced (he moved to a party post, not to another office). The 1988-05-02 schedule entry of the 대통령기록관 records the 당직 개편 without naming the ministers. Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

spells.notes: Moved from 대통령정책담당보좌관. Named and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1989-07-19, 취임식 that afternoon. Sitting 13th-Assembly member (민정당 전국구). He handed his resignation to the Prime Minister on 1990-04-13 amid the 민자당 내분 and the President accepted it on the morning of 1990-04-18, when his successor was appointed (동아일보 and 매일경제 1990-04-18, 중앙일보 1990-04-18, 서울신문 and 한겨레 1990-04-19). 매일경제 of 1990-04-16 had reported the acceptance as due that day, but every later report dates it to the 18th. Later 체육청소년부장관 from 1990-12-27 (sports.ext88.json). Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

Sitting 13th-Assembly member. He offered to resign with the 민자당 당3역 on 1992-05-21. His successor was named on 1992-05-23 (내정, 동아일보 1992-05-24) and on 1992-05-25 the President formally replaced him and gave the successor the 임명장 (동아일보 1992-05-25, 경향신문 1992-05-26). ko.wikipedia ends him on 1992-05-24. Later 내무부장관 from 1993-12-22 (interior.ext88.json). Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

spells.notes: Named on 1992-05-23 as successor-designate (내정) with the 민자당 당3역 개편, formally appointed and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1992-05-25 (동아일보 1992-05-25, 조선일보, 경향신문 and 경인일보 1992-05-25/26). ko.wikipedia gives 1992-05-24 and the 대한민국사연표 1992-05-25. He was a sitting 13th-Assembly member and had been elected to the 14th for 서울 노원을. On 1992-07-20 the Supreme Court recount reversed that result, he handed his resignation to the Prime Minister on 1992-07-21, and the President accepted it on 1992-07-22 when naming his successor (중앙일보 1992-07-23). na_members_12_22.csv ends his 14th-Assembly seat on 1992-09-08 (disqualified). The 대한민국사연표 files the successor's appointment under 1992-07-23. Later 건설교통부장관 in 2001 (land.verified.json). Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

spells.notes: Named on the afternoon of 1992-07-22 to succeed 김용채 (한겨레 1992-07-23 writes 임명·발령). The 임명장 was first announced for the 23rd (서울신문, 경인일보 1992-07-23) and was given on the morning of 1992-07-24 (한국일보, 전북도민일보 and 중부매일 1992-07-25). start follows the 임명장 day as elsewhere in this file, and the confidence is medium because the formal 발령 may carry 1992-07-22, the date ko.wikipedia gives (see issues). Sitting 14th-Assembly member. Replaced in the 중립내각 reshuffle of 1992-10-09, when the President accepted the resignations of the 안기부장 and four ministers including 정무1 and returned the others (경향신문 1992-10-10). 경향신문 1992-10-10 counts him among those who left in that reshuffle. His successor received the 임명장 on the afternoon of 1992-10-09. Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv. [verifier 2026-09-26] Start disputed between 1992-07-22 (appointment reported by every paper, 한겨레 '임명·발령') and 1992-07-24 (임명장, kept). 동아일보 1992-07-25 p.2 has him paying his 취임인사 on the 23rd. See verification.per_spell[9].

spells.transcript_notes: Spell predates the transcript coverage (2000-06 to 2025-01), so no check applies.
spells.notes: Named on the morning of 1992-10-09 in the 중립내각 reshuffle (현승종 제청), 임명장 that afternoon. He was a 중앙일보 고문 and not an Assembly member. He was first slated for 공보처 and the two posts were swapped at the last moment (조선일보, 매일경제 1992-10-09/10). Still in office on 1993-02-20 (매일경제 1993-02-20, 서울신문 1993-02-21) and into the 김영삼 presidency. The first 김영삼 cabinet was named on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1993-02-26, 전북일보 1993-02-26), so the end is the successor's appointment day, as in the sibling files for 내무부, 공보처 and 총무처. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 alone reports that the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and all accepted on 1993-02-25, and ko.wikipedia ends him on 1993-02-25 (see issues). No ko.wikipedia article exists for him (the list links a missing page). birth_date is the year only, from 국민일보 1992-10-09 ('33년 서울에서 태어나'), and gender M from 세계일보 1992-10-10, which names his wife ('부인 이혜경씨'). Birth year source: 국민일보 1992-10-09 "김동익 정무1(중립장관 누구인가)" (BigKinds news_id 01100201.19921009000000110, full text: '33년 서울에서 태어나', accessed 2026-09-26T13:18:13-0400; snapshot roster/sources/special/ext88/news/bk/bk_01100201.19921009000000110.json). Gender source: 세계일보 1992-10-10 "김동익 정무1(새얼굴 프로필)" (BigKinds news_id 01100701.19921010000000206, full text: '부인 이혜경씨(51)', accessed 2026-09-26T13:17:27-0400; snapshot roster/sources/special/ext88/news/bk/bk_01100701.19921010000000206.json). [verifier 2026-09-26] End kept at 1993-02-26 and marked disputed against 1993-02-25 (중앙일보 1993-02-25 acceptance report). New evidence of 이임식 across ministries on 1993-02-26 favours 02-26. See verification.per_spell[10].

spells.notes: Kim Young-sam appointee still in office on 1998-02-25 (caretaker). The 8·5 개각 was announced on the afternoon of 1997-08-05 and the 임명장 were given on 1997-08-06 at 09:30, so start uses 08-06 (no digital gazette before 2001). ko.wikipedia gives 1997-08-05, and 경향신문 1997-08-06 writes '김영삼 대통령은 5일 오후 ... 임명하는 등 11개 부처 장관을 교체하는 개각을 단행했다', so 1997-08-05 is the alternative start (see issues). He held a farewell ceremony on 1998-02-24 but, like the other YS ministers, kept serving after the 1998-02-25 inauguration because the 김종필 consent vote failed (법제처 view that sitting ministers stay until successors are appointed, 한겨레 1998-02-27 BigKinds 01101001.19980227000000405). The office was abolished when 법률 제5529호 took effect on the afternoon of 1998-02-28, so the last full day is 1998-02-27 (same convention as offices.json and the sibling rosters for 공보처, 과학기술처 and 통상산업부). ko.wikipedia gives 1998-03-01. Not reappointed to any successor office (none exists). Birth date from the NA API (na_members_15_22.csv) and ko.wikipedia '홍사덕' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42349301 (snapshot roster/sources/special/wiki_홍사덕.json).

issues.desc: Start convention. In eleven reshuffles the press reported the appointment of this office on one day and the 임명장 on a later day (1987-07-13/14, 1988-05-02/03, 1990-10-12/13, 1991-07-18/19, 1992-05-23/25, 1992-07-22/24, 1993-12-21/22, 1994-12-23/24, 1995-12-20/21, 1996-05-08/09 and 1997-08-05/06). Starts follow the 임명장 day, as in the sibling ext88 files and the main file (홍사덕). nomination_date is the announcement day and outcome_date the 임명장 day. ko.wikipedia uses the announcement day for 최형우 (1991-07-18), 김종호 (1992-07-22), 서청원 (1993-12-21), 김윤환 (1994-12-23), 주돈식 (1995-12-20) and 신경식's end (1997-08-05), and one day early for 김용채 (1992-05-24, where both appointment and 임명장 fell on 1992-05-25).

김종호 start 1992-07-24 (medium). He was named on the afternoon of 1992-07-22 and 한겨레 1992-07-23 writes that he was 임명·발령 that day. The 임명장 was announced for 07-23 and given on the morning of 07-24. With the 임명장 convention the post has no holder on 1992-07-23 (김용채's resignation was accepted on 07-22). If the legal appointment date was 07-22, the start moves to 07-22 and the gap disappears.

김동익 end 1993-02-26 (inferred_from_successor). The first 김영삼 cabinet was named and appointed on 1993-02-26 and the sibling files for 내무부, 공보처 and 총무처 end the 노태우 ministers that day. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 alone reports that the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and all accepted on 1993-02-25, and ko.wikipedia ends 김동익 on 1993-02-25. No report of his own 이임식 was found.

end_reason choices. 김윤환's three spells end when he moved to a party post (원내총무 1988 and 1990, 사무총장 1995) and are coded replaced, since 'other' is used in the sibling files for moves to another cabinet office. 김영구 is coded resigned_to_run because 조선일보 1995-12-20 groups him with the four politician-ministers replaced for the 1996 election, whom the environment and agriculture files code that way. The interior file codes the fifth of them (김용태) as replaced. 이종률 is coded resigned, since the blanket resignation was accepted and nobody took the post that day.

Office identity. Every holder is called 정무제1장관 or 정무1장관 in the press. The (제1) and (제2) titles come from 정무장관실직제 제2조, in force throughout (offices_1988.json), and the 국회·정당 portfolio was written into the 직제 for (제1) only on 1994-11-26. The 정무장관(제2) holders of the same years are in the gender lineage.

News Library OCR text was not compared with the scanned page images. Every start and end also rests on at least one BigKinds story from a different paper, a tier-2 schedule or chronology entry, or a sibling ministry's page. BigKinds and News Library share 동아일보, 경향신문 and 한겨레 from 1990, and the two archives were counted as independent only when the papers differ.

db.history.go.kr did not answer on 2026-09-26 from 13:00 EDT (a 20-second curl timed out), so the 대한민국사연표 days 1995-07-05 and 1996-05-07..05-10 that failed in step 2 were not re-read. The 1995-07-04 entry and the other transition days were read.

Birth dates. 김동익 has the year only (1933, 국민일보 1992-10-09) because no ko.wikipedia article exists and he has no Assembly record. 주돈식's date is from ko.wikipedia only (tier 4). The others are from na_members_12_22.csv.
1988 vacancy. The post was empty from 1988-02-26 to 1988-03-06. No acting head (직무대행) was found in the searched sources. The 정무제1장관실 had 32 staff at the time (조선일보 1988-03-06, 동아일보 1988-03-07).

[verifier] 1993-02-25 against 1993-02-26 for the outgoing 노태우 ministers is not settled panel-wide. This file keeps 김동익 on 02-26, which new 이임식 reports for other ministries on 1993-02-26 support. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 reports acceptance of all resignations on the 25th. Education and foreign ext88 files end on 02-25.

[verifier] 8·5 개각 of 1997. This file and the main-file 홍사덕 use 1997-08-06 (임명장 at 09:30), while roster/justice.ext88.verified.json ends 최상엽 on 1997-08-05 and the main-file 김종구 starts on 1997-08-05. One rule should be applied across lineages.
[verifier] 동아일보 1992-10-17 p.2 (국무총리실 국정감사 table) gives 김윤환's 1988 tenure as 2개월11일, which conflicts with his own 57 days (전북일보 1990-04-19) and with the day-of reports. Recorded, not used.

continuity.note: Handovers follow the sibling files. A replaced holder's end is the successor's 임명장 day (same-day handover), and a holder whose resignation was accepted ends on the acceptance day. The window is covered except for the one-day gap on 1992-07-23, which the 임명장 convention creates (see vacancies and issues). The 1988 vacancy lies wholly after the window start of 1988-02-25, so 1988-02-26..03-06 are days in the window without a holder. window_fully_covered is therefore false.

completeness.method: Holder list rebuilt without ko.wikipedia. (1) Monthly News Library tally of the query 정무1장관, 1988-01 to 1998-02, counting the name printed before the office title (monthly_tally.json, script special_ext88_verify_01_monthly_tally.py). (2) Pre-window searches 1987-07-15..1987-12-31. (3) Contemporaneous retrospective lists: 동아일보 1992-10-17 p.2 (국무총리실 table, ten 6공 정무제1장관 appointments from 김윤환 to 김동익), 경향신문 1992-10-10 p.2 (정무1 changed nine times in the 6공), 매일경제 1995-12-21 p.7 (정무1 김덕룡→서청원→김윤환→김영구→주돈식), 동아일보 1995-04-14 (역대 정무장관 dinner, 서청원 as immediate predecessor).

explanation_of_top_names.1988-02: regex fragment. The month's hits name 이종률 as 정무장관 until 02-24 and the vacancy after the 19th list.
explanation_of_top_names.1991-09: regex fragment (행정위의 국감). 최형우 is named in 1991-08 and 1991-10.
explanation_of_top_names.1992-03: 윤여준 was 정무제1장관보좌관 (차관급), moved on 1992-03-05. 최형우 is named as minister in the same month (조선일보 1992-03-17).
explanation_of_top_names.1992-10: 공보처 precedes 정무1장관 in lists of ministries. 김종호 and 김동익 are the named ministers that month.
explanation_of_top_names.1997-07: no name matched because the News Library prints 辛卿植(신경식)(신경식). The month's hits name 신경식 as 정무1장관 up to 1997-07-26 (경향신문).
explanation_of_top_names.1995-07..1995-11: 김영귀 is the News Library hangul reading of 金榮龜 (김영구) and is the roster holder.

completeness.explanation_of_non_holder_names: All other names printed before 정무1장관 in the tally belong to 보좌관 (차관급) or staff (심재홍, 민해영, 이재원, 윤여준, 윤기병, 정성철, 조경근, 이양희), or are word fragments of the OCR regex.
